## J01 — Analytics Engineer — Juniper Parcel Works
Source [J01-SRC]: https://careers.example.com/juniper-parcel/analytics-engineer (fictional posting dated 2026-09-02).
Company: fictional US delivery-operations software team.
Location/authorization: remote within the US, Illinois eligible; US work authorization required, no sponsorship. Team overlap 10:00–15:00 Central. Travel 5%.
Level: mid-level IC, 3–6 years; no direct reports.
Base salary: USD 135,000–150,000.
Work: model shipment and merchant metrics, build tested ELT transformations, improve operational dashboards, partner with product and finance, document metric definitions.
Required: strong SQL, dimensional modeling, production dbt, Python batch analysis, Git review, data-quality tests and stakeholder communication. Production experience in a cloud warehouse is required; the team's warehouse is BigQuery and migration learning is expected. Snowflake experience is explicitly accepted. Looker is used.
Preferred, not required: production BigQuery, basic Airflow DAG familiarity, logistics-domain experience.
Hiring process: SQL modeling discussion and metrics case study, not a systems/platform-lead interview. No contact provided in this posting.
